heading: Exploring homepage layouts based on the structure of the information hierarchy.

blocks.html: From stakeholder interviews, I discovered drivers often forget packages (>1 Day) in their vehicle, impacting their delivery rates. The strategy involves aligning the layout with their visibility needs, prioritizing reminders for undelivered packages at the top, followed by task entries and other data, organized consistently from most to least important.
